entities.name: Román Méndez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Román Junior Méndez Pérez is a Dominican professional baseball pitcher and coach for the Conspiradores de Querétaro of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Texas Rangers and Boston Red Sox, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hanshin Tigers.
